ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a forest food web, labeled with organisms such as Goat, Jackal, Lion, Wild Cat, Rabbit, Mouse, Owl, Snake, Kite, Green Plant, etc. Wild Cat is located slightly to the right of the center of the image, and Lion is located in the upper right. Near Wild Cat there is a curved arrow pointing to Lion in the upper right. Reasoning: The arrows in the food web indicate food or energy flowing from the prey to the predator. Because the arrow points from Wild Cat to Lion, Lion is the organism that eats wild cats.
